purpose: test whether the rain-synchrony direction persists when inference is driven by weather variation within the same spatial sampling unit rather than between spatial units with different species pools
no_upgrade_rule: these diagnostics cannot upgrade a failed primary or be used to redefine the primary effect; they are reported regardless of direction

naamp.interpretation: sign of within-route association on probability scale; not a replacement for primary binomial OR

frogid.response: multi-species recording vs one-species recording, conditional on >=1 calling species
frogid.estimator: conditional logistic regression stratified by ERA5 cell
frogid.state_effect: absorbed geographically by cell stratum and therefore not separately estimated
frogid.interpretation: within-weather-cell odds association; not a replacement for the frozen validation OR

diagnostic_classification.spatially_robust: both diagnostics negative and 95% CI exclude 0
diagnostic_classification.directionally_consistent_qualified: both diagnostics negative but one or both CI include 0

prohibited: no new spatial subset after results
no dropping low-richness routes/cells based on outcome
no alternate wet-day threshold or dry-spell cap
no replacing the main manuscript effect size with these diagnostics
